doc: creator post history by userId (profile/feed face — fills the ks user_posts matrix gap for the AuthorDossier observed walk). Evidence: oracle probe /rest/v/profile/feed body {userId, pcursor} -> L1 {feeds, host-name, llsid, pcursor, result, webPageArea}, feeds items {type, tags, author, photo{id, timestamp(ms), like_count}, comment.us_c=0}; terminal pcursor="no_more". Cursor form: scientific-notation milliseconds (1.785484910875E12), strictly decreasing after the 2026-09-01 render fix (timestamp-desc stable sort + exact encode/decode); has_more rides the pcursor field (numeric-string truthy, no_more falsy sentinel).
